title: File access built from input (lua) — review required
description: A lua file operation builds its path from input: io.open(dir .. f). Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via normalized prefix check.
remediation: Confine with normalized prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
